_comment: Where the bundle data comes from. See README.md, 'Editing the data'.
sheetId is the long id in the Google Sheets URL, between /d/ and /edit.
Each tab's gid is the number after '#gid=' in the URL when that tab is open.
Set a gid to null and scripts/sync-sheet.mjs will tell you where to find it
rather than guessing and silently syncing the wrong tab.
